meta.parties: The State Graphite Corporation (State Mining and Mineral Development Corporation) v. Fernando, K.S.D.P. and Another

rules.statement: The Court of Appeal will not grant a writ of certiorari where the party seeking it lacks uberrima fides and fails to disclose material facts.
rules.supporting_quote: As Pathirana J held in the case of Alphonso Appuhamy v. Hettiarachchi 17 if a party who moves for a prerogative writ fails to disclose material evidence and so is wanting in uberrima fides, the Court will not grant him relief.
